scenes.title: 二見興玉神社・夫婦岩

photo.alt: 海面上由注連繩相連的夫婦岩

preserve: Two natural sea stacks of unequal size, the taller one to the left and the smaller one to the right
A thick sacred shimenawa rope spans between the rocks; retain its visible connection, height and sag
A small torii on the larger rock; blue open sea, wave texture and distant horizon

scenes.title: 伏見稻荷大社・千本鳥居

photo.alt: 伏見稻荷大社朱紅千本鳥居通道

preserve: A strongly centered passage receding into the distance under many closely repeated vermilion torii
Dark bases of the torii posts and a visible stone path down the middle
Trees and subtle daylight visible around the outer edge; no invented readable Japanese writing

scenes.title: 青岸渡寺三重塔與那智瀑布

photo.alt: 青岸渡寺朱紅三重塔與右側那智瀑布

preserve: The vermilion three-story pagoda is LEFT of center in the foreground; keep all three roof tiers and their proportions
A tall narrow white Nachi waterfall descends from forested cliffs on the RIGHT in the background
Green mountain forest, dark stone cliff, and accurate relative scale and spatial separation of pagoda and falls
